card.name: Earth science and geology text
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or punctuation (of, a period after an initial, an opening parenthesis, a colon) inside earth-science and climate writing, such as paleoclimate papers, geology and fossil course text. It also appears in a few citation-like or scripture-like spots.

modes.label: Linking word in geoscience phrases
modes.description: The word 'of' or an adjective like 'Global' or 'Structural' inside a geology or climate phrase.
modes.example: How the history<< of>> life unfolded and what caused the great events

modes.label: Punctuation in citations and lists
modes.description: A period after an author initial, a parenthesis before a panel letter, or a colon in a verse reference.
modes.example: M. Macias Fauria, S<<.>> Helama, M. Timonen,

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words about hanging, suspension and rebuilding.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words and marks in earth-science and climate passages, such as geology, fossils and ice-core papers.
